hub_identity.reservation_rule: Reserve the ticket (atomic O_EXCL create) before writing runners, artifacts, data, or logs. Existing IDs are rejected across registry, JSONL, tickets, logs, artifacts, data, and runners.

hypothesis: candidate_pool: PIT SEC Companyfacts annual operating leverage acceleration, where revenue grows and operating income grows faster than revenue, paired with liquid SPY-relative confirmation, may identify incremental-margin leaders with better 10d paper replacement value than static profitability or asset-growth variants.
acceptance_rule: docs/backtesting.md Gate 1-4 on the three canonical windows; positive replay is only a lead until shared historical/daily default-off parity exists; reject if EV/PnL regressions, drawdown, sample, survival, concentration, or accepted comparator gates fail.

prediction.confidence_reason: Prior static operating-profit, operating-margin durability, operating-income/assets, and broad Kova quality variants failed or required governors. Dynamic operating leverage is a more targeted incremental-margin hypothesis, but the Companyfacts quality family is crowded and the odds of comparator or drawdown failure are high.

execution_envelope.liquidity_source: price >= $10 and ADV20 >= $50M from PIT OHLCV
execution_envelope.order_semantics: observe-only next-session-open paper entry; no broker order
execution_envelope.portfolio_displacement: none unless a later shared helper and activation gate pass
execution_envelope.kill_switch: trade_enabled remains false; no production adapter changes
execution_envelope.failure_handling: missing annual operating_income/revenue pair, missing prior annual comparison pair, stale facts, missing OHLCV, missing next open, or missing 10d exit rejects the paper candidate

production_impact.parity_note: This experiment changes no production code. A positive result is only a replay lead until a shared default-off helper computes the same PIT annual operating-leverage acceleration gate, liquid SPY-relative confirmation, cooldown, next-open paper entry, 10-day exit, costs, and concentration controls in both historical replay and daily production.

post_run_reflection.why_result_happened: The annual operating-leverage acceleration source did not clear Gate 4 (failed: window_ev_regression, window_pnl_regression, drawdown_drift_too_high, accepted_distribution_pnl_not_beaten). It is not retained or promoted.
post_run_reflection.outcome_summary: Aggregate EV delta +0.6802; aggregate PnL delta $+10,153.60; max drawdown drift +0.0237; 172 paper trades.
post_run_reflection.forbidden_near_neighbor_retry: Do not retry by sweeping revenue-growth, operating-income-growth, operating-leverage spread, margin-expansion, annual fact freshness, RS/close/volume/vol guards, top-N, hold days, cooldown, or notional on these frozen windows.
post_run_reflection.new_evidence_required: A retry needs materially different PIT operating-leverage evidence or closed forward replacement rows. Do not sweep revenue-growth, operating-income-growth, margin-expansion, fact freshness, RS/close/volume/vol guards, top-N, hold, cooldown, or notional on these frozen windows.
